name: Sweep the Stables
subtitle: Honest Work, Honest Coin
description: A Sea Ward stable needs mucking out before the morning ride. Nothing can go wrong. Probably.

name: Deliver the Bread
subtitle: Fresh from the Oven
description: A baker needs a basket of loaves carried across the Trades Ward while they are still warm.

name: Count the Barrels
subtitle: A Dockside Tally
description: A dock clerk wants the day's barrels counted twice. Bring a steady head and a sharp eye.

name: Rats in the Cellar
subtitle: Dock Ward Tavern Trouble
description: A Dock Ward tavern's cellar is overrun with giant rats. Clear them out before closing time.

failure.note: The rats were bigger than promised.

name: The Lost Satchel
subtitle: A Letter Gone Astray
description: A courier lost a sealed satchel somewhere in the Trades Ward. Find it before the City Watch does.

name: Cutpurses at the Market
subtitle: Field Ward Fingers
description: Pickpockets are fleecing shoppers in the Field Ward. Catch them red-handed.

failure.note: The thieves melted into the crowd.

name: Runaway Tressym
subtitle: A Noble's Winged Pet
description: A noble's tressym fled across the Castle Ward rooftops. Bring it home unharmed.

name: Stuck on the High Road
subtitle: A Grain Cart in Peril
description: A grain wagon is stuck in mud outside the north gate with bandits circling. Hold them off.

failure.note: The bandits drove off with the grain.

name: Candles for Dawn
subtitle: Escort the Chandler
description: A chandler needs a guard to carry candles through dark alleys to the temple before sunrise.

failure.note: The candles were smashed in an ambush.

name: The Haunted Privy
subtitle: Spooked in the Southern Ward
description: Residents swear a ghost wails in an old privy. Find out who is really behind it.

name: Unpaid Debts
subtitle: Collecting for Honest Coin
description: A merchant wants debts collected from a stubborn tavern owner without breaking the furniture.

name: Stable Thief
subtitle: Missing Horses at Dawn
description: Three horses vanished from a Sea Ward stable overnight. Track the hoofprints.

failure.note: The trail went cold in the rain.

name: Brawl at the Yawning Portal
subtitle: Keep the Peace
description: A wager gone wrong is turning ugly at the famous inn. Calm things before the Guard arrives.

failure.note: The brawl spilled into the street.

name: Poisoned Well
subtitle: Water Gone Foul
description: A well in the Trades Ward has turned foul. Trace the contamination to its source.

name: The Apprentice's Sludge
subtitle: A Bubbling Mess
description: An alchemist's apprentice let a vat of green sludge loose in the cellar. Contain it.

failure.note: The sludge oozed into the sewers.

name: Dockside Night Watch
subtitle: Short a Guard
description: The City Guard is shorthanded. Walk a tricky night patrol along the harbor.

failure.note: A smuggler slipped past the patrol.

name: The Missing Bard
subtitle: Where Did He Go?
description: A famous bard missed three performances. Find him before his patron's temper flares.

failure.note: He was found, but too late.

name: Warehouse Watch
subtitle: Guard Duty on Dock Street
description: Valuable cargo sits in a warehouse tonight. Stay awake and keep it safe.

failure.note: Thieves tunnelled in from the sewers.

name: Wolves on the Trade Way
subtitle: Hungry Beasts at the Gates
description: Wolves have been harassing travellers on the Trade Way. Drive them off.

name: Locked Out
subtitle: A Wizard's Sealed Door
description: A wizard locked himself out of his shop with a clever spell. Open it without damage.

failure.note: The spell sealed the door tighter.

name: Festival Crates
subtitle: Moving Day for the Fair
description: The summer fair needs stage crates hauled across the city before sundown.

failure.note: A crate of fireworks went off early.

name: The Beggar's Secret
subtitle: A Whisper in the Alley
description: A street beggar claims to have seen something terrible. Earn his trust and hear it.

name: Smugglers' Tunnel
subtitle: A Hole Under the Docks
description: Dockworkers found a tunnel beneath a warehouse. Explore it and report what is inside.

name: The Cursed Coin
subtitle: Don't Spend It!
description: A tavern keeper received a coin that hums at night. Find out what it wants.

failure.note: The coin returned to the tavern.

name: Lost in the Sewers
subtitle: A Child Went Down
description: A child chased a ball down a sewer grate in the Field Ward. Bring them back.

name: The Tax Dodger
subtitle: Forged Merchant Seals
description: A merchant's seals look wrong. Quietly investigate before the tax collectors arrive.

name: Mad Dog of the Docks
subtitle: A Frothing Menace
description: A rabid mastiff has bitten two sailors. Subdue it without killing it.

failure.note: The dog bolted into the harbor.

name: Guard the Wedding
subtitle: Vows and Villains
description: A minor noble's wedding has received threats. Mingle with the guests and watch for trouble.

name: Chimney Sweep Trouble
subtitle: Soot Ward Mishap
description: A noble's chimney is blocked by something that squeaks. Clear it before the dinner party.

failure.note: The soot cloud ruined the carpets.

name: The Missing Goat
subtitle: Field Ward Farmstead
description: A prize goat wandered off toward the city walls. Bring it home.

failure.note: The goat bit back and escaped again.

name: Fishmonger's Feud
subtitle: Dock Ward Shouting Match
description: Two fishmongers are about to come to blows. Calm them before the guard arrives.

name: Barrel Rollers
subtitle: Dock Ward Cargo Chaos
description: A loose cask rolls toward the harbor. Stop it, then haul the rest to the warehouse.

failure.note: The wine went into the bay.

name: Whispers at the Well
subtitle: Trades Ward Rumor Mill
description: A rumor says the well water glows at night. Find out who is spreading it.

name: The Stolen Signboard
subtitle: Castle Ward Petty Theft
description: A tavern's painted sign was stolen overnight. Track it down.

failure.note: The sign was chopped for firewood.

name: Beggars' Blanket Drive
subtitle: North Ward Charity
description: Collect blankets for the poor before the first frost.

name: Spiders in the Attic
subtitle: Sea Ward Pest Control
description: A widow's attic is webbed from floor to rafters. Evict the occupants.

name: The Gambler's Marker
subtitle: Dock Ward Collection
description: A gambler owes a debt and has gone to ground. Persuade him to pay.

name: Spoiled Cargo
subtitle: Dock Ward Inspection
description: A shipment of grain smells wrong. Determine whether it is safe to sell.

name: Lamplighter's Round
subtitle: Trades Ward Night Duty
description: The lamplighter is sick. Light the streets of the ward before dusk falls.

name: Tangled Nets
subtitle: Dock Ward Fishing Fleet
description: A knot of nets has trapped a fishing boat in the harbor. Cut it free.

failure.note: The boat drifted onto the rocks.

name: The Bard's Lost Lute
subtitle: South Ward Crowd Pleaser
description: A bard lost his lute and his nerve. Recover one and rekindle the other.

name: Pickpocket Sweep
subtitle: Market Day Patrol
description: Cutpurses are working the crowd. Watch and catch them red-handed.

failure.note: The thieves took your purse too.

name: Locked Cellar Door
subtitle: Castle Ward Locksmith
description: A merchant's cellar door will not open and he suspects something is behind it.

name: Mud in the Sewers
subtitle: Sewer Cleanup
description: A collapsed tunnel is flooding a street. Shore it up.

failure.note: The tunnel gave way on you.

name: The Herbalist's Order
subtitle: Field Ward Errand
description: Gather rare herbs that grow only outside the city walls.

failure.note: You came back with the wrong plants.

name: Sleepwalking Noble
subtitle: North Ward Night Watch
description: A young lord walks the rooftops in his sleep. Keep him safe until dawn.

failure.note: He woke at the worst moment.

name: Tavern Quiz Night
subtitle: Yawning Portal Trivia
description: A tavern offers coin to anyone who can win its lore contest.

failure.note: You lost to a drunk halfling.

name: The Stubborn Mule
subtitle: Trade Way Troubles
description: A mule blocks the gate and will not move. Traffic is piling up.

name: Haunted Doll
subtitle: South Ward Spookiness
description: A child's doll giggles at midnight. Find out why.

name: Guard the Granary
subtitle: Trades Ward Night Shift
description: Rats and thieves both want the city's grain. Keep watch until morning.

name: Escort the Pilgrims
subtitle: Road to Temple
description: A group of pilgrims needs a safe walk to the temple.

name: Counterfeit Coins
subtitle: Trades Ward Fraud
description: A baker has been paid in lead coins. Find the source.

name: Festival Fireworks
subtitle: Castle Ward Celebration
description: Help a mage's apprentice set up fireworks without burning down the street.

name: The Blackstaff's Errand
subtitle: A Delivery for the Tower
description: A wizard's apprentice needs a fragile crate delivered to a tower without opening it.

name: Zhentarim Skimming
subtitle: Caravan Shortfall
description: A caravan master suspects his guards of skimming goods. Find the traitor.

failure.note: The traitor fled with the loot.

name: Bandits on the Triboar Trail
subtitle: Thornwood Raiders
description: Bandits camp near the Triboar Trail. Scatter them and recover the stolen goods.

failure.note: The ambush caught you in a ravine.

name: The Cassalanter Dinner
subtitle: Poison on the Menu
description: Rumor says a noble family plans something dark at dinner. Go in as staff and look.

failure.note: Staff were thrown out at dawn.

name: Troll Under the Bridge
subtitle: Toll Gone Wrong
description: A troll has claimed a bridge on the South Road. Convince it to leave, or remove it.

name: Missing Silk Shipment
subtitle: Sea Ward Seizure
description: A silk shipment vanished from a bonded warehouse. Follow the paper trail.

name: The Whispering Mask
subtitle: Cursed in the Market
description: A mask for sale in the Trades Ward whispers at night. Learn where it came from.

name: Gnoll Scouts
subtitle: Sighted at Misty Forest
description: Gnoll scouts were seen at the forest's edge. Track them without being noticed.

name: Smuggler's Cove
subtitle: Moonlit Contraband
description: A cove below the cliffs hides contraband. Raid it before the tide comes in.

name: The Haunted Theatre
subtitle: Curtain Call of the Dead
description: A North Ward theatre is haunted by a jealous actor. Put his spirit to rest.

failure.note: The ghost took a bow and a victim.

name: Vigil in the City of the Dead
subtitle: Midnight Tombs
description: Grave robbers have been seen in the City of the Dead. Catch them in the act.

failure.note: The robbers fled into the tombs.

name: Kidnapped Heir
subtitle: A Ransom Note
description: A merchant's heir was snatched. Trace the ransom note back to its author.

name: Wyvern Feathers
subtitle: Cliffside Harvest
description: A tailor needs wyvern feathers. Take them from the nest, not the wyvern.

name: The Bribed Inspector
subtitle: A Crooked Customs Officer
description: A customs officer is on the take. Prove it without raising suspicion.

name: Plague Rats
subtitle: Quarantine Trouble
description: Sick rats have infested a Southern Ward tenement. Contain the outbreak quickly.

name: Rescue from Skullport
subtitle: Freedom by Nightfall
description: Slavers hold three captives in a pen. Break them out before the ship leaves.

name: Guild Rivalry
subtitle: Two Guilds, One Warehouse
description: Two merchant guilds are about to brawl. Settle the dispute peacefully.

failure.note: Both guilds were furious with you.

name: Ghoul Pit
subtitle: Beneath the Old Graveyard
description: Ghouls dig beneath an old cemetery. End the threat for good.

name: The Singing Statue
subtitle: A Plaza Mystery
description: A statue in a plaza sings at night. Find out what animates it.

name: Dragon Cult Rumors
subtitle: Whispers in the Taproom
description: Rumors say cultists meet in a tavern cellar. Infiltrate their gathering.

name: The Poisoned Chalice
subtitle: A Temple Banquet
description: A priest fears poison at a temple feast. Watch, taste, and find the culprit.

failure.note: A guest collapsed before you could act.

name: River Pirates
subtitle: Dangers on the Dessarin
description: Pirates are robbing barges on the river. Board their ship and take back the cargo.

failure.note: The pirates scuttled their own ship.

name: The Dwarven Heirloom
subtitle: A Family's Lost Hammer
description: A dwarf clan lost its ancestral hammer. Find it in a pawnbroker's back room.

failure.note: The hammer had been melted down.

name: Frost Giant Tracks
subtitle: Strange Footprints
description: Giant-sized prints were found north of the city. Track them and warn the garrison.

name: The Duelist's Challenge
subtitle: Honor in the Yard
description: A duelist has challenged a nobleman. Stand in as his champion.

name: Haunted Lighthouse
subtitle: Sea Ward Beacon
description: The harbor lighthouse flickers with a ghostly glow. Ships are in danger.

failure.note: The light went out for good.

name: Spiders of the Deep Market
subtitle: Skullport Fringe
description: Giant spiders are nesting in an abandoned market stall beneath the city.

name: The Mimic Chest
subtitle: Noble Estate Trap
description: A chest in an old villa bites. Open it without losing a hand.

name: Merchant Caravan Ambush
subtitle: Trade Way Patrol
description: A caravan reports bandits near the road. Escort it through.

name: The Silent Choir
subtitle: Temple Mystery
description: A temple choir has lost its voice and no one knows why.

name: Stolen Ship's Cargo
subtitle: Docks Investigation
description: A ship's cargo disappeared overnight. Someone in the harbor knows where.

name: Flooded Catacombs
subtitle: City of the Dead
description: Water has seeped into the catacombs, disturbing the rest of the undead.

failure.note: The dead rose in the flood.

name: Gladiators of the Pit
subtitle: Illegal Fight Ring
description: A hidden fighting pit wants fresh blood. Win a bout or shut it down.

name: The Wizard's Cat
subtitle: Tower Errand
description: A wizard's cat has teleported itself somewhere in the city.

name: Kobold Tunnel Raid
subtitle: Under the City
description: Kobolds are tunneling beneath a bank vault. Stop them.

name: The Merchant Prince's Party
subtitle: Noble Ball
description: Protect a merchant prince from assassins at his own party.

name: Rival Alchemists
subtitle: Guild Dispute
description: Two alchemists accuse each other of poisoning. Find the truth.

name: Bounty on a Bugbear
subtitle: Wanted Poster
description: A bugbear with a price on its head lives in the North Ward ruins.

name: The Silent Bell
subtitle: Temple Tower
description: The great bell will not ring. Something is stuck inside.

name: Smuggled Magic
subtitle: Harbor Crackdown
description: Illegal magic items are slipping through customs. Find the smuggler.

name: The Poisoned Orchard
subtitle: Field Ward Blight
description: An orchard's apples have turned black. Find the cause.

name: Dire Rats of the Sewer King
subtitle: Under the City
description: A rat-king rules a section of the sewers. Take back the tunnels.

name: Escaped Prisoner
subtitle: Dungeon Break
description: A dangerous prisoner escaped through the sewers. Recapture him.

name: The Haunted Mirror
subtitle: Estate Auction
description: A mirror at an estate sale shows the wrong reflections. Neutralize it.

failure.note: The mirror cracked and cursed you.

name: Bridge Toll Bullies
subtitle: Trade Way Thugs
description: Thugs charge outrageous tolls at a bridge. Discourage them.

name: The Lost Heir's Ring
subtitle: Noble Quest
description: A ring of a noble house was lost years ago. Retrace its steps.

name: Wolf Pack in the Fields
subtitle: North Road Hunt
description: A pack of wolves is stalking livestock beyond the walls.

name: Mad Cultists' Rites
subtitle: Back Alley Ritual
description: A handful of cultists chant in a cellar. Break up the ritual.

name: Sinking Shop
subtitle: Dock Ward Disaster
description: A shop is sinking into the mud. Save the stock and the owner.

name: The Dancing Armor
subtitle: Hall of Heroes
description: Armor in a nobleman's hall has begun to dance at night. Quiet it before the guests arrive.

name: First Level of Undermountain
subtitle: Down the Yawning Portal
description: Descend beneath the Yawning Portal and map the first level of the dungeon.

name: Skullport Informant
subtitle: Smoke and Lantern Light
description: An informant in Skullport knows of a smuggling ring. Reach him alive.

name: The Apprentice's Spellbook
subtitle: A Rogue Tome
description: A runaway apprentice stole a dangerous spellbook. Retrieve it before he casts from it.

name: Orc Raid on the Farms
subtitle: Burning Fields
description: Orcs are raiding farms outside the Field Ward. Stop them before they reach town.

name: Altar of the Dragon Cult
subtitle: A Hidden Shrine
description: A dragon cult shrine lies in an old mine. Smash it and recover its relic.

name: The Lich of the Sump
subtitle: Stories from the Sewers
description: A legend says a lich's phylactery lies beneath the sewers. Learn the truth.

failure.note: The legend proved true, and angry.

name: An Eye in the Dark
subtitle: Beholder Rumors
description: A beholder's lieutenant was seen near the docks. Gather proof without engaging.

name: Rescue the Caravan
subtitle: Lost on the Sword Coast
description: A merchant caravan is overdue. Search the road and rescue any survivors.

name: The Witch of the Brambles
subtitle: A Bargain in the Misty Forest
description: A witch has taken a village's lambs. Negotiate, or fight your way through.

failure.note: The witch laughed and cursed you.

name: Troll Hunt
subtitle: Regeneration Trouble
description: A pack of trolls hunts near the road. Use fire to finish what steel starts.

failure.note: The trolls regrew and chased you.

name: The Masked Ball
subtitle: Daggers Under Silk
description: An assassin is rumored to attend a masked ball. Spot him before the toast.

failure.note: The assassin found the toast first.

name: Defiled Shrine
subtitle: Haunting in the North
description: A roadside shrine is defiled and haunting travellers. Cleanse it.

name: Gargoyles of the Rooftops
subtitle: Stone Menace in the Night
description: Gargoyles stalk the rooftops of the Castle Ward. End their attacks.

failure.note: The gargoyles hid among the statues.

name: The Crime Lord's Courier
subtitle: Intercept the Message
description: A crime lord's courier carries a dangerous message. Take it without being seen.

name: The Restless Tomb
subtitle: Stirrings in the City of the Dead
description: A sealed tomb rattles at night. Reseal it for good.

name: Harpy Song
subtitle: Luring Sailors to the Rocks
description: Harpies lure ships onto the rocks near the harbor. Silence their song.

failure.note: The song lured you to the rocks.

name: The Alchemist's Fire
subtitle: A Burning Laboratory
description: A lab is ablaze with strange green fire. Save the alchemist and his notes.

name: Ogre Mercenaries
subtitle: A Contract Dispute
description: Ogre mercenaries refuse to leave an inn after their contract ended. Convince them.

name: The Ghost Ship
subtitle: Fog Over the Harbor
description: A ghost ship drifts into the harbor at dusk. Board it and learn what it wants.

failure.note: The ship vanished with you aboard.

name: Lizardfolk Truce
subtitle: Marsh Diplomacy
description: Lizardfolk raid fishermen on the marsh. Negotiate a truce and learn why.

name: Fiend in a Fine Suit
subtitle: Rakshasa Rumors
description: A well-dressed stranger bribes officials across the Castle Ward. Learn what he really is.

name: The Vault Job
subtitle: Breaking the Bank
description: A corrupt banker holds a stolen deed. Break into his vault and take it back.

name: Wererat Gang
subtitle: Silver Needed
description: A wererat gang runs a Southern Ward alley. Root them out before the full moon.

name: The Floating Tower
subtitle: A Wizard's Folly
description: A wizard's tower floats above the north wall. Rescue him from his own experiment.

name: Collapsed Dwarven Mine
subtitle: Trapped Beneath the Rock
description: A mine in the mountains collapsed. Dig out the trapped miners.

name: The Drow Envoy
subtitle: Skullport Diplomacy
description: A drow diplomat needs safe passage through the city. Not everyone wants her alive.

name: Beneath the Dock Ward
subtitle: Smuggler Tunnels
description: A network of tunnels beneath the docks hides a smuggling ring.

name: The Vampire's Servant
subtitle: Night Ward Hunt
description: A vampire's servant has been abducting travelers. Find him.

name: Burning Warehouse
subtitle: Dock Ward Fire
description: A warehouse is on fire and something screams inside.

failure.note: The fire spread to the next block.

name: Knights of the Silver Rose
subtitle: Honor Guard
description: A knightly order needs help on an escort mission through dangerous roads.

name: The Sunken Chapel
subtitle: Harbor Dive
description: A chapel sank in the bay with a relic inside. Retrieve it.

failure.note: The relic was lost to the deep.

name: Gelatinous Cube
subtitle: Undermountain Janitor
description: A cube scours a corridor in the dungeon. Drive it back.

name: The Doppelganger Merchant
subtitle: Market Mystery
description: A merchant is not what he seems. Unmask the imposter.

failure.note: The doppelganger fled in your shape.

name: Bandit King of the Hills
subtitle: Trade Way Raid
description: A bandit king demands tribute from every caravan. End his reign.

failure.note: The king escaped with the loot.

name: Poisonous Perfume
subtitle: Noble Intrigue
description: A perfume maker sells scents with deadly side effects. Gather proof.

name: The Wyvern's Nest
subtitle: Mountain Climb
description: A wyvern has taken a nest above the high road. Drive it off.

name: Spectral Hound
subtitle: Ghostly Hunt
description: A ghostly hound haunts the cemetery. Lay it to rest.

failure.note: The hound dragged one of you away.

name: The Clockwork Spy
subtitle: Tower Espionage
description: A mechanical spy is sending secrets to a rival. Capture it intact.

name: Thieves' Guild Heist
subtitle: Guild Contract
description: A rival guild wants the guild vault emptied for a fee.

failure.note: The vault guard raised the alarm.

name: Basilisk Cavern
subtitle: Under the Hills
description: A basilisk turned a quarry into a statue garden. End its reign.

name: The Plague Doctor
subtitle: Quarantine Ward
description: A mysterious doctor treats the sick, but the patients vanish.

name: Stirges in the Orchards
subtitle: Field Ward Swarm
description: A swarm of stirges is draining livestock. Burn out the nest.

name: The Ritual of Seven Candles
subtitle: Cult Interruption
description: A cult plans a ritual during the new moon. Interrupt it.

name: Marauders at Sea
subtitle: Pirates of the Bay
description: Pirates are taking ships near the harbor mouth. Board and capture.

name: The Forged Writ
subtitle: Court Case
description: A forged writ could ruin a noble family. Prove it false.

name: Ettin Brothers
subtitle: Giant Trouble
description: Two-headed ettins have been demanding food from a farm.

name: Crypt of the Mad Priest
subtitle: Grave Delving
description: A priest was buried with a cursed text. Retrieve it.

failure.note: The text drove one of you mad.

name: Midnight Auction
subtitle: Black Market
description: A secret auction sells stolen relics. Infiltrate it.

name: Owlbear Rampage
subtitle: Ward Crisis
description: An owlbear escaped a menagerie and is loose in the city.

name: The Bone Collector
subtitle: Cemetery Murders
description: A killer is taking bones from fresh graves. Catch him.

failure.note: The killer vanished into the fog.

name: The Lord's Advisor
subtitle: Palace Intrigue
description: A palace advisor plots to undermine a Lord of Waterdeep. Gather proof and expose him.

name: The Crime Lord's Hideout
subtitle: A Beholder's Lair
description: Raid a crime lord's lair beneath the city and steal his ledgers.

name: Battle at the North Gate
subtitle: Orc Horde Approaches
description: An orc horde marches on the north gate. Hold the line until reinforcements arrive.

failure.note: The line broke under the charge.

name: The Red Wyrm of Mount Waterdeep
subtitle: A Dragon's Lair
description: A young red dragon nests near Mount Waterdeep. Drive it off or slay it.

failure.note: The dragon's breath scorched the party.

name: The Lich's Phylactery
subtitle: Seal It Forever
description: A lich's phylactery has been discovered. Seal it away before the lich returns.

name: The Ghost Fleet
subtitle: Spectral Armada
description: A spectral fleet haunts the harbor. Put the captain to rest.

name: Beneath the Citadel
subtitle: The Forgotten Vault
description: A sealed vault beneath an old citadel awakens. Recover its relic.

name: Vampire Spawn
subtitle: Midnight Feeding
description: Vampire spawn prey on North Ward nobles. Hunt down their master.

failure.note: The master fled as a bat.

name: The Zhentarim Warlord
subtitle: A Border War
description: A warlord marshals mercenaries outside the city. Cripple his supply train.

failure.note: The supply train was a trap.

name: The Black Network
subtitle: Spies Everywhere
description: A spy ring is selling the city's secrets. Unmask its leader.

name: The Storm Giant's Bargain
subtitle: A Request from the Clouds
description: A storm giant demands a service in return for sparing the harbor. Complete it.

name: Mind Flayer Colony
subtitle: Whispers Under Skullport
description: Missing citizens lead to a mind flayer lair. Rescue the survivors.

name: Shadow Thieves
subtitle: A Heist Gone Wrong
description: A guild heist has gone sour. Retrieve the stolen idol before dawn.

name: Demon in the Cellar
subtitle: A Planar Rift
description: A planar rift opened beneath a noble's mansion. Close it before it widens.

name: The Iron Golem
subtitle: A Construct Gone Rogue
description: A guard golem went berserk in the Trades Ward. Disable it without wrecking the district.

name: Tremors in the North
subtitle: The Earth Shakes
description: The ground shakes north of the city. Investigate before panic spreads.

name: Hag Coven
subtitle: Three Sisters of the Moors
description: A hag coven offers deals to desperate villagers. Break their grip.

name: The Assassins' Contract
subtitle: Ink and Blood
description: A guild accepted a contract on a Lord. Find and stop the killer.

name: Giants in the Hills
subtitle: Boulders at Dawn
description: Hill giants pelt a caravan route with boulders. Stop their ambush.

name: Sunken Treasure
subtitle: The Wreck Beneath the Bay
description: A treasure wreck lies beneath the harbor, guarded by sahuagin. Salvage it.

name: Yuan-ti Infiltrators
subtitle: Scales Under Silk
description: Yuan-ti infiltrators pose as nobles. Expose them at the Lord's gala.

failure.note: They slipped away in the crowd.

name: Cult of the Elder Eye
subtitle: A Whisper from Beyond
description: A cult tries to summon something from beyond the stars. Interrupt the ritual.

name: The Forgotten Queen's Tomb
subtitle: A Gilded Crypt
description: A queen's tomb lies beneath the cliffs. Retrieve her crown before it wakes her.

name: Fire Giant Foundry
subtitle: Forge of Flame
description: Fire giants forge weapons in a volcanic cave. Sabotage their foundry.

name: The Thieves' War
subtitle: A Citywide Brawl
description: Two crime lords have started a street war. End it before the city burns.

failure.note: The war spread to the harbor.

name: The Beholder's Lair
subtitle: Undermountain Peril
description: A beholder holds a hidden level of Undermountain. Defeat it.

name: Siege of the Castle
subtitle: Defense Mission
description: A noble castle is besieged by an unknown army. Break it.

name: The Vampire Lord
subtitle: Cursed Manor
description: A vampire lord has claimed an estate in the North Ward.

name: Dragon in the Mines
subtitle: Mountain Rescue
description: A young dragon has taken a mine and its miners. Rescue the survivors.

name: The Mind Flayer's Thralls
subtitle: Underdark Ambush
description: Thralls kidnap citizens for a mind flayer. Find the lair.

name: The Fey Crossing
subtitle: Wild Gate
description: A fey gate opened in the forest and creatures are spilling out.

name: Giant Spider Queen
subtitle: Webbed Underdark
description: A spider queen rules the tunnels beneath a ward. Cut her webs.

name: Hunt for the Devil's Contract
subtitle: Hellish Legal Trouble
description: A devil holds a contract on a citizen's soul. Win it back.

name: Skeletal Legion
subtitle: Necromancer's Army
description: A necromancer is raising a skeletal legion under the graveyard.

name: The Assassin's Guild
subtitle: Murder Contract
description: An assassin guild has put a contract on a Lord. Stop it.

name: The Frost Wyrm
subtitle: Northern Lair
description: A white dragon freezes the northern trade road. Defeat it.

name: City Under the Lake
subtitle: Sunken Ruin
description: Lakeside ruins hide an ancient treasure and its guardians.

name: Hag's Bargain
subtitle: Swamp Deal
description: A hag offers a prize in exchange for something precious. Outwit her.

name: Stone Giants' Gift
subtitle: Mountain Trade
description: Stone giants offer a treaty. Escort the emissary safely.

name: Rooftop Chase
subtitle: Night Pursuit
description: A master thief with a stolen relic flees across the rooftops.

name: The Ghost Ship's Captain
subtitle: Haunted Seas
description: A ghost ship drifts near the harbor with a cursed captain.

failure.note: The ship vanished with a crewmember.

name: Poison in the Palace
subtitle: Noble Murder
description: Someone is poisoning the nobles at court. Find the culprit.

name: Gnoll Warband
subtitle: Frontier Defense
description: A warband of gnolls attacks the outer farms. Break it.

name: Ruined Tower of the Mad Mage
subtitle: Arcane Ruins
description: A tower hides a mad wizard's vault of spells and traps.

name: Stolen Crown Jewels
subtitle: Royal Heist
description: The jewels of Waterdeep are gone. Retrieve them before the festival.

name: The Basilisk Throne
subtitle: Petrified Court
description: A noble court has been turned to stone. Find the cause.

failure.note: You became part of the court.

name: Werebear Pack
subtitle: Moonlit Hunt
description: A pack of werebears is hunting in the foothills.

name: Iron Knight
subtitle: Haunted Armor
description: A suit of armor wanders the old keep and strikes down anyone it meets.

name: The Betrayer General
subtitle: Military Treachery
description: A city general has been feeding secrets to the enemy.

failure.note: He escaped to the enemy lines.

name: Hunt for the Roc
subtitle: Skyward Quest
description: A giant roc carries off cattle and the occasional farmer. End the hunt.

name: The Lord's Ransom
subtitle: Kidnapping at the Palace
description: A Lord of Waterdeep has been taken. Rescue them before the city descends into chaos.

name: Dragon Cult Uprising
subtitle: The Wyrmspeakers March
description: The dragon cult launches a coordinated attack. Strike at the head of the cult.

name: Aboleth Beneath the Bay
subtitle: An Ancient Mind
description: An aboleth enslaves harbor workers. Destroy it and free its thralls.

name: The Ancient Red Dragon
subtitle: The Mountain Awakens
description: An ancient red dragon wakes beneath Mount Waterdeep. Stop it from razing the city.

name: The Lich King's Return
subtitle: A Hunt for the Phylactery
description: A lich returns to claim the city. Destroy his phylactery before the new moon.

failure.note: The lich walked among the dead.

name: The Demon Prince's Gambit
subtitle: A Gate to the Abyss
description: Cultists open a gate to the Abyss beneath the city. Close it at any cost.

name: Siege of Waterdeep
subtitle: Armies at the Walls
description: A coalition besieges the city. Break the siege commander's will.

name: The Great Heist
subtitle: The Crown of the City
description: A heist of the city's crown jewels is underway. Stop it, or steal them first.

failure.note: The thieves escaped through the sewers.

name: The Elder Brain's Plan
subtitle: Ascension Under Skullport
description: An elder brain plots beneath Skullport. Strike before it ascends.

failure.note: The elder brain's minds struck back.

name: The Titan's Hammer
subtitle: A Weapon Awakened
description: A titan's forgotten hammer awakens in the mountains. Seal it away or claim it.

name: The Plague Bringer
subtitle: A Sickness in the Streets
description: A plague spreads from the docks. Find its source and cure it.

name: Dragon Turtle Terror
subtitle: A Storm in the Harbor
description: A dragon turtle sinks ships in the harbor. Slay it or drive it off.

name: The Shadow Throne
subtitle: A Hidden Claimant
description: A hidden claimant plots for a Lord's seat with dark magic. Expose him.

name: The Death Tyrant
subtitle: The Eye of the Grave
description: A death tyrant has risen in the City of the Dead. Banish it before the city wakes.

name: The Phoenix Egg
subtitle: The Reborn Flame
description: A phoenix egg hatches in the mountains. Escort it to a safe nest.

name: Fey Court Invasion
subtitle: Summer and Winter
description: Fey lords invade the Misty Forest. Broker a peace or break their army.

name: Treasure of the Mad Mage
subtitle: The Final Level
description: Delve to the deepest level of Undermountain and seize a legendary treasure.

name: Voices in the Water
subtitle: The Elder Brain's Bargain
description: An elder brain offers power in exchange for the city. Refuse it with force.

name: Elemental Fury
subtitle: Siege of the Wards
description: Elemental lords besiege the city's wards. Lead an assault to end it.

name: The Death Knight's Legion
subtitle: An Undead Army Marches
description: A death knight marches an undead army toward the gates. Break his command.

name: The Archmage's Duel
subtitle: Challenge Across the Planes
description: A rogue archmage challenges the city's wizards. Meet him in the arcane arena.

name: Kraken Song
subtitle: A Cult at Sea
description: A kraken's cult sails from the harbor, summoning storms. Sink their fleet.

name: The Obsidian Gate
subtitle: A Door Between Worlds
description: A gate of black glass opened in the North Ward. Seal it.

name: Waterdeep Burns
subtitle: Saving the City
description: Arcane flame spreads through the wards. Save as many lives as you can.

name: The God's Trial
subtitle: Trial of Heroes
description: A god offers a trial at a forgotten temple. Pass it to earn a blessing.

name: The Dragon's Hoard
subtitle: Vault of Ancient Wyrm
description: An ancient dragon sleeps on its hoard beneath the mountain. Take what you can.

name: The Lich's Phylactery Heist
subtitle: Tower of Bones
description: The lich's phylactery sits in a tomb of traps. Steal it.

name: Avatar of Death
subtitle: Cataclysm
description: A cult calls upon a death avatar. Stop the ritual.

name: The Demon Lord's Seal
subtitle: Abyssal Rift
description: A demon lord is breaking free from his seal. Reinforce it.

name: Storm of Dragons
subtitle: City Under Fire
description: Dragons attack the city skyline. Defend the ward.

name: Fall of the Fortress
subtitle: Siege of the North
description: A great fortress is crumbling under a titan's assault.

name: The Archdevil's Bargain
subtitle: Nine Hells Parley
description: An archdevil offers a bargain no one should accept. Negotiate.

name: Vault of the Gods
subtitle: Divine Treasure
description: A divine vault holds relics of forgotten gods. Open it.

name: Beholder Tyrant
subtitle: Eyes of Terror
description: A beholder tyrant rules an underground empire. End it.

name: The Deep Kingdom
subtitle: Underdark War
description: A deep kingdom marches on the surface. Hold the gates.

name: Titan's Wrath
subtitle: Storm Over the Coast
description: A titan's anger floods the coastline. Appease or defeat it.

name: The Sea King's Trident
subtitle: Sunken Throne
description: A sea king's trident lies in an underwater palace guarded by sea monsters.

name: Reaper of the Fey
subtitle: Wild Hunt
description: The Wild Hunt rides across the countryside. Survive until dawn.

failure.note: The Hunt took one of you.

name: Kingmaker's Gambit
subtitle: Throne Conspiracy
description: A conspiracy plans to topple the city's rulers. Expose it.

name: Primordial Spring
subtitle: Elemental Birth
description: An elemental spring floods the world with chaos. Seal it.

name: The Last Dragon Cult Temple
subtitle: Dragon Cult Fortress
description: The last temple of a dragon cult hides a draconic relic. Burn it down.

name: Plague of the Dead
subtitle: City Quarantine
description: A plague of undead sweeps the poor wards. Find patient zero.

name: The Vault of the Mad King
subtitle: Underworld Heist
description: An underworld king's vault holds a forbidden artifact. Rob it.

failure.note: The king's guards tore you apart.

name: Gate of the Giants
subtitle: Giant Invasion
description: Giants march on the gates of the city. Break their lines.

name: Crown of the Void
subtitle: Eldritch Horror
description: A crown from beyond the stars whispers to a lord. Destroy it.

failure.note: The void consumed one of you.

name: The Great Dragon Race
subtitle: Sky Challenge
description: Dragons race for glory above the city. Join a rider to win.

name: Stolen Moon
subtitle: Celestial Theft
description: A celestial relic called the Moon's Heart was stolen. Retrieve it.

name: Lair of the Kraken
subtitle: Sea of Swords
description: A kraken guards a hoard of drowned ships. Recover the artifacts.

name: The Eternal Garden
subtitle: Fey Paradise
description: A garden outside time ensnares travelers. Escape with the prize.

name: Cataclysm at the Gates
subtitle: Final Defense
description: A cataclysm approaches the city. Hold the line.
